outcome: Proportion of obstetric patients with relevant cardiac disease
cohort: 56 women who underwent transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) in the intensive care unit after caesarean section over a 5-year period
finding: Echocardiography demonstrated a high prevalence of cardiac abnormalities in women who underwent TTE after caesarean section, suggesting that preoperative echocardiography may be appropriate in high-risk obstetric patients.
